steps.title: Domains and TLS
steps.subtitle: Match your public hostname to Open WebUI's WEBUI_URL.

steps.title: Reverse proxy
steps.subtitle: Point BunkerWeb at Open WebUI, upgrade its socket and wait for slow models.

steps.title: Methods, request rate and body sizes
steps.subtitle: Allow the web app's own methods, load without throttling and accept long chats and large uploads.

steps.title: Security - Real client address
steps.subtitle: Replace a client-sent X-Forwarded-For so Open WebUI sees the real address; also set FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS on the app.

steps.title: HTTP - Many users behind one address
steps.subtitle: Each open tab holds one WebSocket: raise the per-address connection limit for offices and schools.

steps.title: HTTP - Voice, camera and location
steps.subtitle: Let Open WebUI use the microphone, camera, screen share, location, speaker choice and fullscreen. To turn one off, set it back to (), for example camera=().

steps.title: Security - Single sign-on cookie
steps.subtitle: Open WebUI's SSO sign-in reads its token cookie from JavaScript, so that one cookie keeps HttpOnly off. If you use passwords only, clear the field.

steps.title: HTTP - Large single sign-on cookies
steps.subtitle: Accept and forward the big token cookies that OpenID Connect sign-in leaves behind. Password-only sign-in does not need this.

steps.title: Security - Bad behavior ban
steps.subtitle: Open WebUI answers 403 to every page load while channels are off: raise the ban threshold, or set ENABLE_CHANNELS=true on the app.

steps.title: Security - Review chat text CRS exclusions
steps.subtitle: Skip injection rules for the text typed into chats, notes, prompts and model settings.
